dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible on the upper dorsal-lateral region are at least three prominent 'C' and 'O' shaped patterns. A central 'O' structure exhibits a jagged, high-contrast dark perimeter with a soft gradient transitioning into a lighter grey interior. Two adjacent 'C' structures towards the anterior and posterior show sharper, more defined geometric boundaries on their dorsal edges.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A high concentration of small, solid light-pixel clusters is observed on the upper shoulder and neck area. These clusters lack internal gradients and appear as dense, localized asymmetrical blobs against the darker fur.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three primary macro-annuli form an obtuse triangle oriented longitudinally along the dorsal ridge. The high-intensity blobs cluster in a secondary, more chaotic cloud-like formation roughly midway between the anterior and central macro-annuli.
